mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ia.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ya.JM_CD , ya.JM_NM AS xx_jm_cd , ya.JASAN_GB , ya.CURRENCY , ia.FUND_CURRENCY FROM SYM0YA ya LEFT OUTER JOIN SYM0YZ yz ON yz.CORP_GR = ya.CORP_GR AND yz.JM_CD = ya.JM_CD INNER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = yz.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = yz.FUND_CD WHERE yz.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yz.YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{fYmd}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{tYmd}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY ya.JASAN_GB ASC , ia.FUND_CD ASC , ya.JM_CD ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(yz.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , yz.TRUSTEE , yz.TR_BFIL_JUSU + COALESCE(yz.RIGHT_JUSU, 0) AS tr_bfil_jusu , yz.TR_UP_JUSU , yz.TR_DW_JUSU , yz.TR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(yz.RIGHT_AEK, 0) AS tr_bfil_chui_aek , yz.TR_UP_CHUI_AEK , yz.TR_DW_CHUI_AEK , yz.TR_PYUNGA_AEK , yz.FCUR_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(yz.RIGHT_FCUR_AEK, 0) AS fcur_bfil_chui_aek , yz.FCUR_UP_CHUI_AEK , yz.FCUR_DW_CHUI_AEK , yz.WON_BFIL_CHUI_AEK + COALESCE(yz.RIGHT_WON_AEK, 0) AS won_bfil_chui_aek , yz.WON_UP_CHUI_AEK , yz.WON_DW_CHUI_AEK , yz.BFIL_SUNG_COST , yz.SUNG_COST , yz.FCUR_BFIL_SUNG_COST , yz.FCUR_SUNG_COST , yz.WON_BFIL_SUNG_COST , yz.WON_SUNG_COST , yz.BFIL_MISU_IJA , yz.MISU_IJA , yz.FCUR_PYUNGA_AEK , yz.FCUR_PYUNGA_SONIK , yz.FCUR_HWAN_CHA , yz.FCUR_BFIL_MISU_IJA , yz.FCUR_MISU_IJA , yz.WON_PYUNGA_AEK , yz.WON_PYUNGA_SONIK , yz.WON_HWAN_CHA , yz.WON_BFIL_MISU_IJA , yz.WON_MISU_IJA , yz.MSD_MEIB_AEKM , yz.MSD_MEIB_AEK , yz.FCUR_MSD_MEIB_AEK , yz.WON_MSD_MEIB_AEK , yz.MSD_MEDO_AEKM , yz.MSD_MEDO_AEK , yz.FCUR_MSD_MEDO_AEK , yz.WON_MSD_MEDO_AEK , F_CURRENCY_RT(yz.CORP_GR, yz.YMD, yz.CURRENCY) AS currency_rt FROM SYM0YZ yz WHERE yz.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yz.YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{fYmd}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{tYmd}, '[^0-9]', ''), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') AND yz.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND yz.JM_CD = #{jmCd} ORDER BY yz.YMD ASC
